title: Concept: pnpm lockfile on an older format
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares a `lockfileVersion` from the pnpm 5/6 era, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `lockfileVersion` from the pnpm 5/6 era.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: Without a recorded digest the downloaded artifact cannot be checked against what was reviewed, so substitution is undetectable at install time. This rule reads a `lockfileVersion` from the pnpm 5/6 era.
